reason: I have been burned paying for slides before, but here I pay nothing up front, the first 3 meetings are free and I can strike out the bad ones, so the worst case is EUR 900 for 3 real buyer meetings. I will take the free 15-company list first and only start the pilot if the list shows they actually understand freight and 3PL buyers in that market.
objection: One unnamed logistics client with 45 meetings is not proof. I worry the 'qualified' meetings will be junior people taking a polite call with no intention to switch forwarder, and I could buy Apollo and put a junior SDR on it for the same money and keep the know-how in house.
would_change_my_mind: If the free list of 15 companies is generic, with companies I already know or that obviously do not buy our kind of service, I walk away and do not start the pilot.
